name: LATAM Airlines Credit Card

apr.notes: APR not visible on product page; see Rates and Fees disclosure (linked but not fetched).

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees stated on page for both Mastercard and World Elite Mastercard.

rewards.redemption_notes: Earn LATAM Pass Miles to redeem for new adventures and dreams with LATAM Airlines. Welcome Bonus miles do not count toward LATAM Pass Elite status.

signup_bonus.description: 40,000 miles welcome bonus after spending $2,500 in the first 3 months

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Use your card when you travel just as you do at home, with no fees for the purchases you make abroad.

benefits.title: LATAM Airlines-operated VIP Lounges
benefits.description: Enjoy the comfort of the LATAM VIP lounges, located in 5 of the most important airports in our destination network. 2 lounge visits. Exclusively for LATAM Airlines World Elite Mastercard cardholders.

benefits.title: Cabin Upgrade via Courtesy Segments
benefits.description: Earn Courtesy Segments and live the experience in Premium Economy or Premium Business cabins on LATAM Airlines flights. Up to 2 Courtesy Segments. Exclusively for LATAM Airlines World Elite Mastercard cardholders.

benefits.title: Qualifying Points for LATAM Pass Elite Status
benefits.description: Earn Qualifying Points towards LATAM Pass Elite status and Elite status benefits. 30% qualifying points.

lounge_access.notes: LATAM Airlines-operated VIP Lounges, 2 visits (World Elite only)

other: Cabin Upgrade via Courtesy Segments (up to 2, World Elite only)
Qualifying Points towards LATAM Pass Elite status (30%)

notes: Verified from official LATAM Pass product page. This entry is for the World Elite Mastercard variant ($99 annual fee). The page also lists a non-elite Mastercard variant with no annual fee.
